title: Itsy Bitsy Spider: How Spiders Climb Smooth Water Spouts!

lines.text: The itsy bitsy spider climbed up the water spout!
lines.caps: The *ITSY bitsy | spider *CLIMBED up | the water *SPOUT!

lines.text: How can a tiny spider walk up smooth metal and glass without falling?
lines.caps: How can a *TINY | spider walk up *SMOOTH | metal and glass *WITHOUT | *FALLING?

lines.text: Down came the rain and washed the spider out!
lines.caps: Down *CAME the | rain and *WASHED | the spider *OUT!

lines.text: Under a microscope, each spider foot has hundreds of thousands of tiny hairs!
lines.caps: Under a *MICROSCOPE, | each spider *FOOT | has hundreds of thousands *OF | tiny *HAIRS!

lines.text: These hair tips grab onto invisible microscopic bumps on the smoothest walls!
lines.caps: These hair *TIPS | grab onto *INVISIBLE | microscopic bumps on the *SMOOTHEST | *WALLS!

lines.text: Out came the sun and dried up all the rain!
lines.caps: Out *CAME the | sun and *DRIED | up all the *RAIN!

lines.text: And the itsy bitsy spider climbed up the spout again with super sticky feet!
lines.caps: And the itsy *BITSY | spider climbed up the *SPOUT | again with super *STICKY | *FEET!

lines.text: Now you know the real superpower behind the Itsy Bitsy Spider!
lines.caps: Now you *KNOW | the real *SUPERPOWER | behind the *ITSY | Bitsy *SPIDER!
